analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter difficulties with the [product_name] web editor and would prefer a user interface similar to [product_name] for remote system control via mobile or PC. There are compatibility and user experience gaps compared to more advanced editors. Users also face barriers accessing third-party apps because of regional payment options.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward, feature-rich editor similar to [product_name], that facilitates remote access and control from internet-enabled devices. They also want app solutions that are easy to obtain and compatible with local payment methods.
